questions.text:
A particle moves in a circular path with decreasing speed. Choose the correct statement 
:

options.C: Particle moves in a spiral path with decreasing radius
options.D: The direction of angular momentum remains constant

questions.text:
A block of mass m is at rest under the action of force F against a wall as shown in figure. 
Which of the following statement is incorrect?

options.A: f = mg [where f is the frictional force]
options.B: F = N [where N is the normal force]

questions.text:
A simple pendulum has time period T1. The point of suspension is now moved upward 
according to the relation y = Kt2, (K = 1 m/s2) where y is the vertical displacement. The 
time period now becomes T2. The ratio of (T12)/(T22 ) is (g = 10 m/s2).

From a circular disc of radius R and mass 9M, a small disc of radius R/3 is removed from 
the disc. The moment of inertia of the remaining disc about an axis perpendicular to the 
plane of the disc and passing through O is:
Which of the following sets have different dimensions?

options.D: Dipole moment, Electric flux, Electric field

graph given below correctly represents the variation of acceleration displacement?

Three infinitely long charge sheets are placed as shown in figure. The electric field at 
point P is :

A photon collides with a stationary hydrogen atom in ground state inelastically. Energy of 
the colliding photon is 10.2 eV. After a time interval of the order of micro second another 
photon collides with same hydrogen atom inelastically with an energy of 15 eV. What will be 
observed by the detector?

options.C: One photon of energy 10.2 eV and an electron of energy 1.4 eV
options.D: One photon of energy 10.2 eV and another photon of energy 1.4 eV
